name: dra-agent
description: Agent 画布 —— 可视化 AI 工作流创作平台（client + server 双包 monorepo）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER,ELECTRON -c cyan,green,yellow "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.electron:build: npm --prefix client run build:rel && npm run bundle:server && npm run stage:server && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
